title: Preview: August non-farm payrolls by the numbers
description: What's expected: Consensus estimate +56K (range -25K to +121K) July -23K June +63K Private consensus estimate +45K Unemployment rate consensus estimate: 4.1% vs 4.1% prior Participation rate consensus 61.4% prior Prior underemployment U6 prior 7.9% Avg hourly earnings y/y exp +3.0% y/y vs +3.2% prior Avg hourly earnings m/m exp +0.3% vs +0.1% prior Avg weekly hours exp 34.3 vs 34.3 prior August jobs so far: ADP employment report +38K (lowest since Jan) vs +47K expected and +46K prior ISM services employment 47.8 vs 47.4 prior ISM manufacturing employment 51.2 vs 52.5 exp and 52.8 prior Challen

title: Economic and event calendar in Asia Friday, September 4, 2026 - a light one
description: Data due from South Korea, Japan and Singapore. These are not marked as priority items and unless something is way off expectations are unlikely to move markets too much upon release. This article was written by Eamonn Sheridan at investinglive.com.

title: Bank of Canada unveils new vertical $20 bank note
description: Her Excellency the Right Honourable Louise Arbour, Governor General of Canada, and the Honourable Wayne Long, Secretary of State (Canada Revenue Agency and Financial Institutions), joined Bank of Canada Governor Tiff Macklem today at an event to unveil Canada’s new vertical $20 bank note featuring a portrait of His Majesty King Charles III.
